{{Quote|Assuming my translation is accurate, this ancient text from the planet Forntay relates how the primitive inhabitants rose up and defeated superior oppressors. Sadly, the natives are now extinct.|Emiel Skoff|<ref name="GG62" />}}
'''Forntay''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="GG62" /> located in the [[Forntay system/Legends|Forntay system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> According to a text from Forntay that was ancient by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and that was translated by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] educator [[Emiel Skoff]]&mdash;who was researching historical insights that would aid the outnumbered Alliance prevail over the Empire&mdash;the planet was at one point home to a group of [[Unidentified Forntay inhabitants|native inhabitants]]. Skoff characterized the group as primitive, and supposedly it had been subjugated by a faction utilizing superior forces. According to the ancient text, Forntay's native inhabitants ultimately carried out a successful insurrection against their oppressors; however, the group eventually also went extinct. During the Galactic Civil War, Skoff relayed the fate of Forntay's inhabitants as translated from the text.<ref name="GG62" />

==Behind the scenes==
Forntay was first mentioned in [[Mark Rein-Hagen]] and [[Stewart Wieck]]'s [[1990]] [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''.<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Forntay [[Star system/Legends|system]]&mdash;albeit misspelled as the "Fortnay" system&mdash;and therefore the planet itself, in grid square L-12.<ref name="TEA" />
